phase: manual cross-mechanism organization, not new experiment or unified implementation

rows.use: selected CPU topology set used to acquire rq locks
rows.relation: conditional target coverage by actual lock objects before the protected use
rows.specialized: set membership, logical CPU/lock alias and setup/online stage
rows.observations: historical boot samples and bounded fact adapter
rows.unclosed: exact first content read and stability/alias window

rows.use: Btrfs max_inline option and file path
rows.relation: distinguish prepared c=d from observed min(r,c)=min(r,d) and resulting file layout
rows.provider: disk geometry to cached field before numerical consumption
rows.specialized: numeric cap, option range and sectorsize/PAGE_SIZE path gate
rows.observations: historical mounts, option operands, watchpoint intervals and disk layout
rows.unclosed: same-object same-consumption authoritative geometry and all use preconditions

rows.use: SMMU invalidation command and page-table lifecycle
rows.relation: purpose-qualified command coverage/encoding with object publication and submission event order
rows.provider: walker, gather, invalidation encoder and queue
rows.specialized: address stride/leaf/walk encoding and published/private table role
rows.observations: original function callbacks and qualified queue transcripts
rows.unclosed: hardware completion, actual concurrency and supported SVA platform

rows.relation: backend-qualified target object, maintenance footprint and per-object ownership/publish/reclaim stage
rows.provider: allocator/ABI, virtqueue, DMA backend, architecture maintenance
rows.specialized: address domains, coherent/bounce, maintenance versus requested range
rows.observations: host layouts, original function chains and instrumented AArch64 maintenance sequences
rows.unclosed: real target/ABI/coherence/effective granule plus device/cache/concurrency effects

common: local relation separate from whole-path verdict
